name: Vital Strategies BOTEC
summary: Advocates for alcohol policies, such as in Vietnam, to reduce drinking and the deaths it causes. GiveWell's spreadsheet "Vital Strategies BOTEC", linked from its grant page. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.

rows.label: Value of preventing one death from alcohol
rows.explainer: GiveWell's moral weight, 57 units of value, times your multiplier on the value of a life.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
